display.name: Grain
display.summary: Searches and reads Grain meetings, transcripts, notes, coaching, and deals.
examples: What did customers say about pricing this month?
Show my action items from last week.

agent.name: grain
agent.description: Searches and reads Grain meeting data available to the signed-in user: meetings, transcripts, AI notes, participants, companies, coaching feedback, and connected HubSpot deals.
agent.owns: You own recorded meetings in Grain that this user attended or can access. You only read. Coaching and deal tools require a Business or Enterprise plan, and deal tools require the HubSpot integration.
agent.first_for: Grain meetings, transcripts, and AI notes

tool_descriptions.myself: Get the signed-in user's Grain account information.
tool_descriptions.list_meetings: List accessible meetings with company, person, date, participant, and title filters.
tool_descriptions.list_attended_meetings: List meetings attended by the signed-in user with filtering and pagination.
tool_descriptions.fetch_meeting: Get detailed information about a meeting by its UUID.
tool_descriptions.fetch_meeting_transcript: Read a meeting transcript, optionally including timestamps.
tool_descriptions.fetch_meeting_notes: Read AI-generated notes for a meeting.
tool_descriptions.search_meetings: Semantically search meeting transcripts with meeting and speaker filters.
tool_descriptions.search_companies: Find companies that participated in meetings for use in meeting filters.
tool_descriptions.search_persons: Find meeting participants by name or email for use in meeting filters.
tool_descriptions.list_workspace_users: List users in the Grain workspace.
tool_descriptions.list_coaching_feedback: List AI-generated sales coaching insights; requires a Business or Enterprise plan.
tool_descriptions.fetch_meeting_coaching_feedback: Read the coaching scorecard for a meeting; requires a Business or Enterprise plan.
tool_descriptions.list_open_deals: List open HubSpot-connected deals and their Grain intelligence; requires a Business or Enterprise plan.
tool_descriptions.list_all_deals: List all HubSpot-connected deals and their Grain intelligence; requires a Business or Enterprise plan.
tool_descriptions.fetch_deal: Read detailed Grain intelligence for a HubSpot-connected deal; requires a Business or Enterprise plan.
